por_que: Exploración de estilo: Lucas pide más invención llamativa (props, escala, humor) como rubenholgado/paulcuffaro y sus dos ejemplos (olla gigante de fideos + garrafa de leche; chaleco salvavidas + coco ante un crucero con alfombra roja). Elige en el artifact las que más se parecen a lo que quiere.
prefijo_1311: Create a YouTube thumbnail, 16:9 landscape, everything important in the central area. Attached image 1 is the man: keep his exact face, wavy brown hair, full beard, build, grey sleeveless hoodie and red work gloves (same person, do not beautify or change his age).
prefijo_ramon: Create a YouTube thumbnail, 16:9 landscape, everything important in the central area. Attached image 1 is the man: keep his exact face, wavy brown hair, full beard, build and grey sleeveless hoodie (same person, do not beautify or change his age).
sufijo: STYLE: like a top YouTube thumbnail: simple and bold, one huge hero element, bright saturated daylight colors, clean uncluttered background, everything razor sharp, his face large and well lit. Photorealistic, like a real photo, not an illustration, no plastic AI skin. No text, no logos, no watermarks, nothing in the bottom-right corner.

conceptos.idea: Reloj de arena gigante casi vacío en el borde; él metido en el estanque abrazando una montaña de plantas, cara seria a cámara
conceptos.escena: SCENE: a giant hourglass, as tall as him, stands on the wooden edge of a garden pond, the sand almost run out. He stands knee-deep in the pond hugging a huge armful of reeds and elephant-ear plants with dripping roots, staring straight into the lens with wide eyes and a deadpan face. White picket fence and palms behind.

conceptos.idea: Trasplante literal: lleva en brazos un trozo entero de estanque (tierra, agua, juncos y un nenúfar) como una tarta
conceptos.escena: SCENE: he carries in his arms a whole chunk of pond like a giant cake: a block of earth with water sloshing on top, reeds and a water lily growing from it, water pouring over the sides. Behind him an empty wooden-framed pond waits. He looks into the lens, wide-eyed, deadpan.

conceptos.idea: Carretilla desbordada de plantas más altas que él, y el perro blanco sentado encima
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is his dog: keep the exact same big white dog. SCENE: he pushes a wheelbarrow overflowing with pond plants taller than himself, and the big white dog sits proudly on top of the plants. He looks into the lens, exhausted and deadpan. Garden pond and white fence behind.

conceptos.idea: El perro en medio del estanque con un calcetín en la boca y una planta en la cabeza; él detrás, resignado
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is his dog: keep the exact same big white dog. SCENE: the big white dog stands in the middle of a freshly planted garden pond, soaking wet, a striped sock in its mouth and a water plant on its head, looking proud. Behind it he holds a small plant and stares into the lens, resigned and deadpan.

conceptos.idea: Tierra de cemento: pala doblada clavada; él con un martillo neumático y una planta al lado
conceptos.escena: SCENE: a garden spade bent in half sticks out of rock-hard, cracked grey ground. He holds a big jackhammer, safety goggles pushed up on his forehead, and looks into the lens with a deadpan face. Next to him a reed plant waits to be dug out. White picket fence behind.

conceptos.idea: Sostiene una planta cuyas raíces están metidas en un bloque de cemento gris
conceptos.escena: SCENE: close-up, he holds toward the lens a reed plant whose roots are completely encased in a solid block of grey concrete, chunks cracking off. He looks at the camera over the block, eyebrows raised, deadpan. Blurred garden behind.

conceptos.idea: El pajarito gigante en primer plano bañándose en la tinaja; él pequeño detrás asomándose con ojos muy abiertos
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the bird: keep the exact same species and plumage. SCENE: the tiny bird bathing in the water on top of a dark glazed jar, huge and razor sharp in the foreground with splashing droplets; he peeks from behind the jar in the background, wide eyes, hand on the jar.

conceptos.idea: Luna llena enorme en el cielo de día; él plantando con el móvil enseñando las fases lunares
conceptos.escena: SCENE: a gigantic full moon fills the daytime blue sky behind him. He kneels at a garden pond planting a reed with one hand and holds up his phone showing a moon phase calendar with the other, looking into the lens with a serious face.

conceptos.idea: Corre con plantas en los dos brazos y un cronómetro colgado del cuello; plantas cayéndose
conceptos.escena: SCENE: he runs toward the camera along a garden pond, both arms full of pond plants with roots, some plants falling, a big stopwatch hanging from his neck. Motion, energy. He looks into the lens, panicked but determined.

conceptos.idea: Estanque partido sin línea: mitad selva exuberante, mitad grava vacía; él en medio
conceptos.escena: SCENE: one garden pond seen from a low angle: the left half is an explosion of lush tropical plants, flowers and reeds, the right half is still bare gravel and still water, one continuous scene with no dividing line. He kneels in the middle between both halves holding a plant, looking into the lens.

conceptos.idea: Picado: estanque gigante lleno de plantas exóticas y él diminuto en el centro con una paleta
conceptos.escena: SCENE: top-down drone view of a big rectangular garden pond with a wooden frame, packed with lush exotic water plants; he is tiny in the middle, standing in the water with a small trowel, looking up at the camera. Red gloves as the color accent.

conceptos.idea: El perro huye con una maceta entera en la boca; él persiguiéndolo, salpicaduras
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is his dog: keep the exact same big white dog. SCENE: the big white dog runs toward the camera with a whole potted plant in its mouth, water splashing; behind it he chases, arms out, mouth open in a shout. Garden pond and white fence.

conceptos.idea: Sostiene ante la cara una bolsa transparente con peces pequeños (medakas); el estanque detrás
conceptos.escena: SCENE: he holds up in front of his face a clear plastic bag of water with many tiny silver fish (medaka), the bag big in the foreground; behind him the half-planted garden pond. He looks at the camera through the bag, eyebrows raised.

conceptos.idea: Despertador antiguo sonando en el borde del estanque; él lanzándose a plantar
conceptos.escena: SCENE: a big vintage red alarm clock ringing on the wooden pond edge in the foreground, vibrating. Behind it he dives forward into the pond with a plant in each hand, water splashing, looking at the clock with alarm.

conceptos.idea: Metido hasta la cintura en el estanque salvaje sacando un lirio con raíces de dos metros
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the wild rocky pond with a red concrete edge. SCENE: he stands waist-deep in that wild rocky pond pulling out a yellow iris whose pale roots are absurdly long, two meters, hanging down to the water. He looks into the lens, deadpan.

conceptos.idea: Una hoja de alocasia más grande que él como paraguas, con el perro debajo
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is his dog: keep the exact same big white dog. SCENE: he holds a single giant elephant-ear (alocasia) leaf bigger than himself like an umbrella over his head, the big white dog sitting under it next to him. Garden pond behind. He looks into the lens, deadpan.

conceptos.idea: Lleva al hombro un arce japonés rojo como un trofeo; puentecito rojo japonés en el estanque
conceptos.escena: SCENE: he carries a small red Japanese maple tree on his shoulder like a trophy, proud; behind him a garden pond with a small red arched Japanese bridge and a stone lantern. He looks into the lens with a confident half smile.

conceptos.idea: El estanque convertido en jardín japonés: farol de piedra, puente rojo; él plantando
conceptos.escena: SCENE: a garden pond styled like a Japanese garden: stone lantern, small red arched bridge, bamboo, reeds, a dark glazed jar. He kneels on the wooden edge planting, looking up into the lens, surprised by how good it looks.

conceptos.idea: El perro ha cavado un agujero sin esfuerzo donde él no puede; pala rota en su mano
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is his dog: keep the exact same big white dog. SCENE: the big white dog sits proudly next to a deep, perfect hole it has dug in rock-hard cracked ground; he stands next to it holding a broken spade handle, staring into the lens, deadpan.

conceptos.idea: Él cubierto de barro de pies a cabeza y el perro blanco impecable al lado; una sola planta diminuta
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is his dog: keep the exact same big white dog. SCENE: he is covered in mud from head to toe, holding up one tiny plant; next to him the big white dog is perfectly clean and fluffy. Garden pond behind. He looks into the lens, deadpan.

conceptos.idea: Planta mustia «reanimada» con una mascarilla de oxígeno y un gotero
conceptos.escena: SCENE: he holds a wilted pond plant with roots that wears a tiny oxygen mask connected to a small IV drip bag hanging from a stick, like a patient being revived. He looks into the lens with a worried, serious face. Garden pond behind.

conceptos.idea: Torre de cajas de plantas más alta que él tambaleándose; él haciendo equilibrio
conceptos.escena: SCENE: he balances a wobbling tower of green plastic crates full of pond plants, stacked twice his height, walking along the edge of a garden pond. He looks into the lens with wide, worried eyes.

conceptos.idea: Anubis como una joya: cojín de terciopelo rojo, foco; él con guantes blancos de joyero
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the tortoise: keep the exact same species, shell pattern and size. SCENE: the tiny tortoise sits on a red velvet jewelry cushion under a bright spotlight, like a precious diamond, in the foreground; he leans behind it wearing white cotton jeweler gloves, wide eyes, deadpan.

conceptos.idea: Anubis en la palma bajo una cúpula de cristal de museo
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the tortoise: keep the exact same species, shell pattern and size. SCENE: he holds the tiny tortoise in his open palm toward the lens, covered by a small glass museum dome. He looks into the lens with raised eyebrows. Dark plain background.

conceptos.idea: Anubis diminuta encima del caparazón de una sulcata gigante; él agachado
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the tiny tortoise, image 3 the giant tortoise: keep both exact species. SCENE: the tiny tortoise stands on top of the giant tortoise's shell; he crouches next to them, eye level, looking into the lens with wide eyes. Bare reddish ground.

conceptos.idea: Anubis en un maletín forrado de terciopelo esposado a su muñeca, como diamantes
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the tortoise: keep the exact same species, shell pattern and size. SCENE: he holds open a black briefcase lined with velvet, handcuffed to his wrist; inside, the tiny tortoise sits like a treasure. He looks into the lens, serious, like a secret agent.

conceptos.idea: Tortuga rusa en caja de regalo con lazo; un humidificador echándole vapor; él preocupado
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the tortoise: keep the exact same species and shell. SCENE: the tortoise sits in an open gift box with a big bow; a humidifier next to it blows thick mist onto it. He holds the box, looking into the lens, worried.

conceptos.idea: Dos terrarios: uno empapado con niebla y gotas, otro seco de desierto; la tortuga en el mojado; él limpiando el cristal
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the tortoise: keep the exact same species and shell. SCENE: two terrariums side by side in one shot: the left one soaking wet, foggy, water dripping down the glass, with the tortoise inside; the right one a bright dry desert. He wipes the foggy glass, looking into the lens, worried.

conceptos.idea: Tortuga rusa encima de un manual gordísimo; él leyendo otro
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the tortoise: keep the exact same species and shell. SCENE: the tortoise sits on top of a huge thick instruction manual; he holds another enormous open manual, looking over it into the lens with a tired, deadpan face.

conceptos.idea: Una docena de crías de cuello de serpiente estirando el cuello hacia un grillo en la punta de su dedo
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the baby turtle: keep the exact same species, long neck and shell. SCENE: a dozen of these baby turtles in shallow water all stretch their long necks toward one cricket on his gloved fingertip; he watches from behind, wide-eyed. Dark green water.

conceptos.idea: Una cría de cuello de serpiente en una cucharilla con el cuello estirado; él a la altura de los ojos
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the baby turtle: keep the exact same species, long neck and shell. SCENE: one baby turtle sits in a teaspoon he holds toward the lens, its long neck stretched out of the spoon; his face right behind at eye level, eyebrows raised.

conceptos.idea: Frenesí: crías de cuello de serpiente atacando grillos con salpicaduras en un barreño; él asomado
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the baby turtle: keep the exact same species. SCENE: a feeding frenzy in a tub of water: many baby snake-necked turtles strike at crickets, water splashing everywhere, frozen in motion. He leans over the tub, looking into the lens, deadpan.

conceptos.idea: Abre una puerta de casa normal y sale una selva con cascada y niebla; lagarto caimán en el umbral
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the jungle room and its green lizard: keep the lizard's exact species. SCENE: he opens an ordinary white house door in a terracotta wall and a dense jungle bursts out: waterfall, mist, vines spilling onto the doorstep, the green lizard sitting on the threshold. He holds the handle, looking into the lens, deadpan.

conceptos.idea: Sentado en un sillón dentro de la sala-selva leyendo el periódico; lagarto caimán en el reposabrazos
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the jungle room and its green lizard: keep the lizard's exact species. SCENE: he sits in a comfy armchair inside the jungle room next to the waterfall, reading a newspaper, the green lizard resting on the armrest. He looks over the paper into the lens, calm.

conceptos.idea: Sostiene un globo terráqueo con tortugas y lagartos encima de los continentes
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is a tortoise: keep the exact same species. SCENE: he holds a big globe toward the lens; small tortoises and lizards stand on top of the continents (Africa, South America, Asia). He looks over the globe into the lens with a confident half smile.

conceptos.idea: Inundación: él con botas de agua y chubasquero; la sulcata gigante subida al tejado de su caseta
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the giant tortoise and its low concrete shelter: keep the exact same species. SCENE: the garden is flooded ankle-deep; the giant tortoise sits on top of the roof of its concrete shelter, dry; he stands next to it in yellow rain boots and a raincoat holding an umbrella, looking into the lens, deadpan.

conceptos.idea: Construye una casa sobre pilotes para la tortuga gigante, que lo mira
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the giant tortoise: keep the exact same species. SCENE: he stands on a half-built tortoise house raised on tall stilts, hammer in hand; below, the giant tortoise looks up at it. He looks into the lens with a proud half smile.

conceptos.idea: Rodeado de 8 cajas de regalo con animales asomando (tortuga, cuello de serpiente, lagarto)
conceptos.escena: Images 2 and 3 are animals: keep their exact species. SCENE: he sits surrounded by eight open gift boxes with bows; from them peek the tiny tortoise, a baby snake-necked turtle stretching its neck, and a green lizard. He looks into the lens, wide-eyed and excited.

conceptos.idea: Anubis ante pirámides diminutas de arena en su recinto; él tumbado a su altura
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the tortoise: keep the exact same species, shell pattern and size. SCENE: the tiny tortoise walks in front of small sand pyramids in its desert enclosure, like Egypt, low camera at tortoise level; he lies on the floor behind it, chin on his hands, looking into the lens.

conceptos.idea: Una cría de cuello de serpiente asomando por el borde de una taza de café en su mesa
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the baby turtle: keep the exact same species, long neck and shell. SCENE: a baby snake-necked turtle peeks over the rim of a coffee cup on a table, its long neck stretched out, big in the foreground; he sits behind holding the cup handle, staring into the lens, deadpan.
